item.proficiency.mace.desc: Trains Maces. A hit while falling smashes: harder the further you fell.
proficiency.welcome.body: Doing a thing makes you better at it. Every level in a skill buys a talent point for that skill's tree. At 25 a skill gets a signature move; at 50 an ability on %1$s. Press %2$s, then click a skill to open its tree. Deep enough in two trees and a synergy wakes.
